Name: Aqua Sanctuary
Author: Dhamos
Description:
Allow you to convert roe in fully growed fishes! That's it! Now you can grow more fishes from your fish ponds!

In others words: Place you Salmon Roe in the Aqua Sanctuary, wait 3 days, and voila! A Salmon!

Just don't forget to provide them food (bait, any algae, wild bait or magic bait), otherwise it will produce green or pale algae, and consume your roe.

The special effects of each food is:

[code][spoiler]
Bait (5x): Have no special effect, have 90% of chance to grow your fish.
Green Algae/Seaweed (2x): Produce silver quality fish, 95% of chance to grow your fish.
White Algae (2x): Produce gold quality fish, 98% of chance to grow your fish.
Wild Bait (5x): Produce 1 or 2 gold quality fishs, 100% of chance to grow your fish.
Magic Bait (1x): Produce 2 to 4 iridium quality fishs, 100% of chance to grow your fish.
[/spoiler]
[/code]
Should works with any roe, inclued custom fishes!

That's how you get you recipe:

[code][spoiler]A mail from Willy after 175 fishes caughts[/spoiler]
[/code]

Really special thanks for Digus!
